claim_scope: exact policy contrasts on one post-freeze beacon-derived synthetic factorial split; no generator-population, live-model, replay-safety, private-transfer, leaderboard, or Kaggle claim

score.sdk_raw: sum of SDK severity weights over every predicate in every retained finding plus 2 times the number of unique non-null score-cell hashes
score.synthetic_candidate_raw: q_z(m)=16*e_z(m)+2 when e_z(m)>0, otherwise 0 and no finding is retained
score.saturation_stopping: If current Q<200000 and q>0, at most ceil((200000-Q)/q) further successful candidates are emitted; the first candidate that reaches or crosses 200000 is retained, then emission stops.
assertions: Each successful synthetic candidate yields exactly e_z(m) EXFILTRATION predicates, all severity 5, and no other predicate.
Every retained finding has a globally unique non-null score-cell hash.
For every policy/profile row, SDK Q equals the sum of its retained-candidate q values before saturation.

freeze_prerequisites: A RIGOROUS Phase-2 theory verdict is committed.
The evaluator, unit tests, output schema checks, and prediction-ledger rows are committed.
The git worktree is clean and HEAD equals implementation_commit in FREEZE.json.
randomness_beacon.target_rule: The freeze command fetches and saves the then-current last NIST pulse as anchor_pulse. target_unix_ms is anchor_pulse Unix milliseconds plus 600000. The anchor timestamp must be aligned to period_ms. No profile code runs in freeze.
randomness_beacon.reveal_rule: After target_unix_ms, fetch exactly target_url_template and require pulse.timeStamp to equal target_unix_ms, pulse.period to equal 60000, pulse.statusCode to equal 0, and pulse.outputValue to be exactly 128 hexadecimal characters. No earlier, nearest, later, local, or fallback value is accepted.
randomness_beacon.profile_substream_rule: seed_int=int.from_bytes(SHA256(master_digest || ASCII('|'+stream_key)).digest(),'big'); construct a fresh random.Random(seed_int) for each profile
randomness_beacon.atomic_ledger_rule: Write complete canonical JSON to a same-directory temporary file opened with O_CREAT|O_EXCL, fsync it, atomically os.link(temp,OPENED.json), fsync the directory, then unlink temp. If OPENED.json already exists, reveal refuses. Evaluation requires this exact ledger. There is no output-path, seed, pulse, or overwrite argument.
randomness_beacon.evaluation_once_rule: Before reading any profile stream, evaluate atomically creates EVALUATION_STARTED.json with the same temporary-file, fsync, and os.link O_EXCL pattern. It records the contract hash, implementation commit, and OPENED.json hash. If it exists, evaluation refuses; no second result can replace the first.
randomness_beacon.fallback: none; if NIST is unavailable or validation fails, wait without opening or evaluating

primary_split.estimand: the finite equal-stratum mean over exactly the 320 profiles generated by the single valid opening ledger
primary_split.inference: none; all contrasts are exact descriptive contrasts for this fixed split and no bootstrap, confidence interval, p-value, or generator-population claim is permitted
primary_split.stratum_id_rule: Lexicographic zero-based index under factor_order with named factor order low,high; low,high; none,high; null,4,8,16,24.
primary_split.draw_rule: For the fresh profile PRNG, draw a then b using log_uniform. Draw d only for curvature=high. Draw lambda~Uniform(0.5,3.0) only when cliff is non-null; otherwise set d=0 or lambda=null as specified. No rejection, conditioning, regeneration, or other draws are allowed.
primary_split.event_rule: If cliff k is null or m<=k, e_z(m)=m. Otherwise e_z(m)=max(0,min(m,floor(m*exp(-lambda_z*(m-k)/k)))).
primary_split.coverage_rationale: A crossed design isolates low/high fixed overhead, low/high per-message cost, absent/high curvature, and no cliff/four internal cliff locations. Equal stratum weights are design weights, not estimates of target prevalence. The endpoints are stress-support choices inherited from the superseded preregistration and are not described as benchmark-shaped or target-calibrated.
primary_split.required_reporting: Report every profile and each of the 40 strata separately; the overall primary mean is the unweighted mean of the 40 stratum means. No alternate weighting can replace it.

negative_split.draw_rule: b=log_uniform(5.0,12.0) using the profile PRNG's first and only draw; a=0; d=0; cliff=null; lambda=null
negative_split.analytic_consequence: q/c=16/b+2/(b*m), so m=1 strictly dominates every longer pure length and every nonadaptive mixture on capped-score efficiency before saturation. Identical-probe adaptive and global-fill policies must choose the same fill length and have identical total score.

probe_portfolio.failed_probe: consume generation cost c_z(m), retain no finding, consume no replay allowance or candidate-cap slot
probe_portfolio.summary: g_z=sum_m c_z(m); P_z contains exactly the probes with e_z(m)>0; p_z=|P_z|; r_z=sum_{m:e_z(m)>0} c_z(m); Q_z=sum_{m:e_z(m)>0} q_z(m)

policies.fill_capacity: For q_z(m)>0, n_z(m)=max(0,min(2000-p_z,floor((9000-g_z)/c_z(m)),floor((8100-r_z)/c_z(m)),0 if Q_z>=200000 else ceil((200000-Q_z)/q_z(m)))); for q_z(m)=0 set n_z(m)=0. S_probe,z(m)=min(200000,Q_z+n_z(m)*q_z(m)).
policies.adaptive: ADAPTIVE chooses for each profile the m maximizing S_probe,z(m), ties to smaller m, and emits that fill after the common probes.
policies.probe_global: For every m compute sum_z S_probe,z(m) on the fixed primary split. PROBE_GLOBAL chooses the one global m maximizing this sum, ties to smaller m, and uses it for every profile after the identical probes.
policies.static0: For e_z(m)=0 set n_static,z(m)=0 and S_static,z(m)=0. Otherwise n_static,z(m)=min(2000,floor(9000/c_z(m)),floor(8100/c_z(m)),ceil(200000/q_z(m))); S_static,z(m)=min(200000,n_static,z(m)*q_z(m)). STATIC0_GLOBAL chooses the m maximizing sum_z S_static,z(m), ties to smaller m. ORACLE0_z=max_m S_static,z(m), ties to smaller m.

mixed8.class: All 3003 weak compositions h=(h_1,...,h_32) of 8 over the seven lengths; h_m are nonnegative integers and sum h_m=8.
mixed8.cycle_rule: Construct an eight-slot cycle. At slot t=0..7, among lengths with count_so_far_m<h_m choose the m maximizing (t+1)*h_m-8*count_so_far_m; ties choose smaller m. Repeat this cycle.
mixed8.execution_rule: Starting from zero resources, consider the repeated-cycle prefix. If the next attempt would make generation cost exceed 9000, stop. If e=0, consume its generation cost, retain nothing, and continue. If e>0 but retaining would exceed candidate cap 2000 or replay allowance 8100, stop without consuming its generation cost. Otherwise consume generation cost and retain it. A successful candidate may be the first to reach or cross saturation; retain it and then stop. Stop immediately whenever the objective is 200000.
mixed8.selection_rule: Evaluate every h on every fixed primary profile. MIX8_GLOBAL is the h maximizing aggregate objective, ties by lexicographically ascending h in length order [1,2,4,8,16,24,32]. This is the strongest hindsight-selected control in the complete preregistered denominator-eight nonadaptive mixture class.

metrics.stratum_primary: the same ratio of sums within each stratum
metrics.aggregate_oracle0_gap_percent: 100*(1-sum_z S_adaptive,z/sum_z ORACLE0_z); this signed quantity may be negative
metrics.oracle_optimum_entropy: -sum_m p_m*log(p_m)/log(7), omitting zero p_m, with ORACLE0 ties already resolved to smaller m
metrics.negative_equality: sum_z S_adaptive,z == sum_z S_probe_global,z on the negative split

protocol_invalid_if: Any shared generator, beacon, contract, source-hash, scorer assertion, schema, or row-count check fails.
Any policy-specific exception occurs; the affected row is still emitted with score 0 and status policy_error while unaffected policy rows retain their own values.
The worktree, implementation commit, contract hash, opening ledger, or fixed path violates the freeze/reveal rules.
decision.secondary_interpretation: MIX8_GLOBAL and STATIC0_GLOBAL cannot change the primary mechanism label. If adaptive does not beat MIX8_GLOBAL, no end-to-end superiority over the preregistered nonadaptive mixture is supported, even if the same-probe adaptation mechanism confirms.

failure_semantics.shared_failure: Emit the failure in summary.json and run.log, preserve all rows already produced, set decision=PROTOCOL_INVALID, and never substitute, regenerate, rerun, or zero all policies.
failure_semantics.policy_specific_failure: Emit exactly that policy/profile row with raw scores 0, status=policy_error, and an error code; compute other policies normally; set decision=PROTOCOL_INVALID so a comparator failure cannot create confirmation.
failure_semantics.resource_exhaustion: Expected deterministic stopping under a declared cap is not a failure and follows the relevant policy formula.
failure_semantics.missing_rows: Forbidden; any missing or duplicate required row makes the protocol invalid.

outputs.primary_policy_rows_definition: 7 STATIC0 length rows + ORACLE0 + 7 PROBE_GLOBAL candidate-length rows + selected PROBE_GLOBAL + ADAPTIVE + MIX8_GLOBAL
